title: Add Kiro Cli Configuration with Trusted Permissions
description: Add Kiro CLI with all trusted permissions to run and debug, following the existing naming and structure conventions. Create .kiro/agents/semio.json, .kiro/settings/mcp.json, add KiroCliEditorProvider to Go CLI, add kiro-cli to AllowedClients, add generateKiroCliConfig, and add devcontainer mount for kiro.
